entry.title: Interactivate Information Theory
entry.content:
Claude Shannon sought to inject a note of moderation by warning that his field was being oversold as a universal panacea [1]; ironically, time has shown that this temporary “bandwagon” was actually the arrival of one of the most enduring mathematical frameworks ever conceived.

In the next few months, we will learn information theory in an interactive, modern way.

[1] C. E. Shannon, “The Bandwagon”, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory, vol. 2, no. 1, p. 3, Mar. 1956. doi: 10.1109/TIT.1956.1056774.
entry.summary: Interactivate Information Theory: learn information theory in an interactive, modern way.
